about.p1: Every line of my code is hand-written. No page builders, no copy-pasted themes. Just HTML, CSS and JavaScript, shaped until it feels right.
about.p2: I'm 24, based in Tehran, with an associate degree in programming and a B.Sc. in computer engineering in progress. I started with C# and SQL, spent time programming ARM microcontrollers, and settled on the front-end. Off the keyboard I follow the markets, so I think in data, timing and risk.

tiles: One layout that works on every screen

gold-desk.title: Gold Desk (XAUUSD)
gold-desk.desc: Candlestick chart, lot-size and risk calculator, and a trade journal with statistics. Simulated data, unit-tested logic.
gold-desk.imageAlt: Gold Desk: a candlestick chart with entry, stop and target lines beside a position-size calculator

nira-cafe.title: Nira Café (concept)
nira-cafe.desc: Bilingual EN/FA café website with full RTL support, live opening hours, a tabbed menu and a reservation form that exports to your calendar.
nira-cafe.imageAlt: Nira Café website in Persian, right-to-left, with a steaming coffee cup illustration

circuit-shop.title: Voltix store (demo)
circuit-shop.desc: Search, filters, sorting, product dialogs, a persistent cart, free-shipping progress and a validated checkout. Generated product art, no image files.
circuit-shop.imageAlt: Voltix electronics store: a grid of product cards with a filter sidebar and cart badge

flow-board.title: Flow Board (Kanban)
flow-board.desc: Drag and drop plus keyboard and touch controls, undo, search, due dates and JSON import/export, on an immutable, tested board model.
flow-board.imageAlt: Flow Board: three Kanban columns with priority-tagged cards

pars-tools.title: Pars Tools
pars-tools.desc: Jalali ↔ Gregorian converter checked against the platform calendar on 73,000 days, number-to-words, age calculator and digit converter. Persian-first.
pars-tools.imageAlt: Pars Tools in Persian showing the Jalali and Gregorian date converters

portfolio.title: This portfolio
portfolio.desc: Bilingual (EN/FA) site with RTL support, theming, motion and a content-driven build with automated checks.
portfolio.imageAlt: The portfolio hero with a live candlestick chart behind the name CHARON
